interpretation_limits: World toe-axis values use the character forward axis derived from the pelvis; rest-axis offsets are separated from animation deltas.
Stable heel/toe points are fixed vertex-index centroids selected by rest-pose Foot/ToeBase weights; they do not switch to a different lowest vertex each frame.
Contact threshold 40mm is a measurement band; contact counts and speeds require visual interpretation.
Normalized stance width is affected by source/target bone proportions.
Direction error describes retarget fidelity and does not judge naturalness.
